context: Visible next-server v16.2.10 was already listening. C3 bound it for GL-004 RUNTIME_TRACE instead of spawning a second runtime.
result: Binder refuses spawn. Isolated next build uses a private distDir. GL004_PROVEN stays false unless all five named children exit 0. GL005_PROVEN is never granted by this executor.

laws.rule: A live Next process satisfies RUNTIME_TRACE only when PID, PPID, cmdline, cwd=repo, listen port owned by that PID, HTTP GET / == 200 with Next.js identity, HEAD, start time, and runtime log are bound in one receipt.
If a qualifying live process exists, do not start another Next server. --spawn is refused. Do not kill the live process.
laws.evidence: EXIT_SPAWN_REFUSED=7; no start/dev invocation in the binder.

laws.rule: next dev HTTP is not next start and is not next build. Production runtime remains unproven until mode=start is bound.
GET / == 200 proves the bound PID serves Next identity. 401/404/500 on APIs are execution evidence, not health PASS.
next build into .next-gl004-proof via child-only distDir preload is compile proof. It must not listen. It must not replace the live .next used by next dev.

reusable_lessons: Repair PowerShell twin must implement the same exits and payload keys.
Do not promote these laws to CANONICAL until the atomic receipt has been falsified by C1 and still holds.
